name: Loop
title: Loop: free Magnet alternative
hook: Magnet charges you five bucks to snap your Mac windows into place. This app does it for free.

features.intro: Hold a key, flick your mouse, done.
features.say: A radial menu snaps your window into halves, quarters or thirds, with a live preview first.
Prefer the keyboard? Assign any key to any action. You can even tweak the menu and preview to your style.

caption:
Magnet costs $4.99 one-time. Loop snaps your Mac windows into place for free 🪟

✅ Radial menu: hold a key, move your cursor, window snaps
✅ Halves, quarters, thirds and more, with a live preview
✅ Your own keyboard shortcuts, plus a menu and preview you can restyle
✅ No subscription, no account, 100% free

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Needs macOS 13 or later, and you have to give it Accessibility permission to move windows

Comment "SNAP" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
